\bThere was a great war at that time, in a region far from here.

\bThe energy that could be gained by the sacrifice of so many Pokémon…
\bThere are surely many people who would call it reprehensible.

\bThanks to Infinity Energy, Devon was able to become one of the top industries in Hoenn and developed into the giant you see today.
